references.text: Sebah and Zalmunna are mentioned earlier in the chapter as the Midianite kings whom Gideon pursues
Gideon captured Sebah and Zalmunna, the two Midianite kings mentioned in this verse
Describes the Midianites and the people of the East lying in the valley, countless as locusts
The Lord turned their swords against each other throughout the camp, leading to the great losses mentioned in this verse
Killed the Midianite princes Oreb and Zeeb, part of the same military campaign
The psalm mentions Sebah and Zalmunna as examples of God's judgment on enemies
Isaiah refers to the day of Midian as an example of God's deliverance, which includes this victory
Refers to the defeat at Midian as a picture of God's judgment
